citations.claim: initial total energy before any bounce
final energy exceeds initial plus 10%+5J tolerance with no controller work
ball near apex moving slowly while system energy has grown ~89J

counterfactual.change: changed body 0 restitution e from 1 to 0 only; same steps/dt/gravity. Inelastic bounces dissipate energy so no energy growth occurs and energy_bound passes.

explanation: Single ball dropped from rest (y~9.63) with e=1, gravity 9.81, dt~0.025 bounces on floor with no controller/work. Restitution-1 bounces should conserve at best, but contact solver with positional correction/split substeps injects net energy each bounce (~45J by step 500, ~89J by step 997), eventually exceeding E0*1.1+5. Setting e=0 removes the gain, proving bounce handling is the source.
vision_note: The blue ball is near the top of the arena and shows almost no motion across steps 994 to 997. No floor or wall contact, collision, or other sudden jump is visible in this narrow window.
